question: Which of the following festivals is celebrated primarily by the Parsi Community?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jashan-e-Mihragan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__

• **Jashan-e-Mihragan** is one of the most significant festivals celebrated by the Parsi community.

• The festival is dedicated to **Mithra**, the divinity of contracts, and is associated with the harvest season.

• It is a time for **thanksgiving** and sharing meals with family and friends, promoting social harmony and community bonding.

• The festival usually involves **ritual prayers, offerings, and festivities** that include music, dance, and traditional Parsi cuisine.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Parsi Community**

• The Parsi community is a Zoroastrian ethnic group who migrated to India from Persia (modern-day Iran) to escape religious persecution during the Islamic conquest.

• Zoroastrianism is one of the world's oldest continuously practiced religions, founded by the prophet Zoroaster in ancient Iran approximately 3,500 years ago.

• Parsis have greatly contributed to the economic, industrial, and cultural development of India, especially in Mumbai and Gujarat.

• **Songkran**

• Songkran is the Thai New Year festival celebrated primarily in Thailand.

• It is known for its water festival, where people splash water on each other to symbolize cleansing and renewal.

• **Milad-un-Nabi**

• Milad-un-Nabi is the celebration of the birth of the Prophet Muhammad, observed by Muslims around the world.

• The day is marked by prayers, sermons, and religious gatherings.

• **Deepawali**

• Deepawali, also known as Diwali, is a major Hindu festival celebrated by millions of people worldwide.

• It signifies the victory of light over darkness and good over evil, and involves lighting lamps, bursting firecrackers, and sharing sweets.
